Import a Haplotype Data Sheet (HDS) into the internal geno list

Source: R/eukaryotyping.R
euk_import_hds.Rd

Import a Haplotype Data Sheet (HDS) into the internal geno list

Usage

euk_import_hds(
  data,
  locinames,
  locinames_base = locinames,
  ploidy = rep(2L, length(locinames)),
  include_seq_id = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A `data.frame` with a `Seq_ID` column and one column per haplotype per locus. Presence is marked by `"X"`.

locinames

Character vector of marker names (as used in column names).

locinames_base

Optional character vector of base marker names for markers split into sub-markers. Defaults to `locinames`.

ploidy

Integer vector (1 = haploid, 2 = diploid) for each locus in `locinames`.

include_seq_id

Logical. Should the `Seq_ID` column be kept in the output? Default `TRUE`.

Value

A `data.frame` with `Seq_ID` and columns named `<slot>_Hap_<lociname>`, plus a `geno` attribute containing the list of per-locus integer matrices.
